text: Make me an 8-second looping video wallpaper for my phone in vertical 9:16, with soft blue and purple glowing ribbons moving slowly on a dark background. Leave the top third mostly dark for the clock. No words or sound, and make the loop seamless with no jump. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?
